description: Delegated ACME DNS-01 surface /acme/txt (INFRA-PROVIDER annexe B.5, contrat C2, lot P6 jalon M2). Envelope = A.2 with the GRAVED exception: key = gateway_pub (multibase), mandate = [] — the authority is the control-plane mapping of the signing gateway key (the B.2 model), never a mandate chain. Order, fail-closed: presence -> envelope form (key multibase + mandate [] are FORM on this surface) -> host/method/path -> body_b3 -> skew +/-300 s -> nonce -> signature -> verb (PUT/DELETE else not_covered) -> body form (closed {hostname, value}, lowercase LDH hostname, value 1..255 of [A-Za-z0-9_-]) -> mapping (resolve by gateway_pub -> suspended -> tenant state -> hostname match) -> rate (PUT only, <= 10 per rolling hour per hostname) -> DNS effect (TXT _acme-challenge.<hostname>, TTL 60, UPSERT replaces; DELETE idempotent; server purge after 600 s is out of wire scope). Errors: registre A.7 + mapping_mismatch (403). server_now is an input: replay needs no wall clock. Cases are a STATEFUL sequence per plane (nonces burn, the rate window slides). Generated independently (Python blake3 + PyNaCl), gateway keys are committed TEST keys.

cases.name: accept_put_ok
cases.note: the graved B.5 exception: key = gateway_pub, mandate = [], authority = the control-plane mapping; TXT posed, TTL 60

cases.name: accept_delete_ok
cases.note: DELETE retires the record; purge after 10 min is the backstop

cases.name: accept_put_loose_body_json
cases.note: the body is bound by BLAKE3 bytes, not by canonicality: non-JCS JSON with the same closed fields is accepted

cases.name: accept_skew_boundary_300s
cases.note: |now - at| = 300 s exactly: within tolerance (A.2 #5)

cases.name: reject_clock_skew_301s
cases.note: 301 s > 300 s tolerance

cases.name: reject_nonce_replayed
cases.note: the accept_put_ok envelope presented again

cases.name: reject_signature_invalid
cases.note: envelope signature corrupted (last byte)

cases.name: reject_envelope_missing
cases.note: every /acme route demands the envelope — never a banner

cases.name: reject_mandate_not_empty
cases.note: B.5 graves mandate: [] — a chain on /acme/* is a form fault, never evaluated

cases.name: reject_owner_fragment_key
cases.note: B.5 graves key = gateway_pub (multibase): an owner fragment is a form fault — there is no DID on this surface

cases.name: reject_body_unknown_field
cases.note: the body field set is closed: {hostname, value}, nothing else

cases.name: reject_value_too_long
cases.note: value > 255 chars (B.5 bound)

cases.name: reject_value_empty
cases.note: an empty value poses nothing

cases.name: reject_value_bad_charset
cases.note: value alphabet is base64url [A-Za-z0-9_-] — the ACME digest shape, nothing else reaches DNS

cases.name: reject_hostname_case
cases.note: hostnames are strict lowercase LDH on this surface — the client posts its enrolled name verbatim, no case games

cases.name: reject_hostname_trailing_dot
cases.note: no trailing dot, no empty label

cases.name: reject_body_b3_mismatch
cases.note: the envelope signs one body, the request carries another (A.2 #4)

cases.name: reject_wrong_host
cases.note: host binds the authority: no cross-plane replay (A.2 #3)

cases.name: reject_mapping_unenrolled
cases.note: a key enrolled for no tunnel — same answer as a wrong hostname, no enumeration oracle (B.2 model)

cases.name: reject_mapping_foreign_hostname
cases.note: the hostname MUST belong to the signer's binding (B.5)

cases.name: reject_get_not_covered
cases.note: the route defines PUT and DELETE only — default deny, decided AFTER the envelope authenticated (A.3 model)
